text_block_list.text: —A mock race scheduled to take place on an actual racecourse one day.

Though a precious opportunity,
the weather unfortunately brought heavy pouring rain.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
The rain doesn't seem to be letting up.
It's been a while since I ran in a downpour like this...

text_block_list.name: Competing Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—What should we do... in rain like this?
—Be careful not to slip, and then...
For <chrname>'s sake as well, I want to observe closely how one navigates such adverse weather conditions.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—It is time for the race.
Horse Girls, please move to the gates.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
—Amid the torrential rain, the gates spring open.
(Splash splash splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(The outside is completely blocked.
...Should I wait for an opening from this position?)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kh, no. Let them pass first.
First, safely move to the outside...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I might fall behind as a result.
But—it's okay. I know...!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Even in the rain. Even atop sheer cliffs.
Even beneath the snow, life breathes and blooms.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
What matters is accepting it.
Accepting, and adapting.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Supple, tenacious, and deeply rooted.
That is the strength of nature.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
And I stand here today,
nurtured by that very nature.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
The spirit of nature that took root within me without my knowing.
That is mine, my very own...—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Run! Run! Run!
Hang on! Hang on! Hang on!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: (Just... a bit... more...!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Kh, YAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainers
text_block_list.text:
—S-Seriously...?
—She w... won. From back there...?
Cutting through the rain behind the duel for the lead, a black shadow suddenly materialized.
Her closing burst of speed, accelerating sharply and powerfully, was like a beast tearing through the wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Whew~~.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

The victor smiled.
She was unmistakably covered in mud, yet—

Her presence was noble.
And clad in an untainted, pure beauty.
